goals.title: Verify that perception_baseline_node dies because sync_tolerance_sec...
goals.objective: Verify that perception_baseline_node dies because sync_tolerance_sec is passed as a string from eufs_perception_baseline launch, then minimally fix the launch typing so bbox_source:=yolov8 starts perception_baseline_node far enough to create /cones and /cones/viz publishers. Tier LIGHT: one launch-file bugfix inside an existing layer; success criteria are static/failing-first proof of string parameter before edit and post-fix launch dry-run/runtime parameter type no longer rejects sync_tolerance_sec.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/ROS launch evidence: run ros2 launch eufs_perception_baseline perception_baseline.launch.py bbox_source:=yolov8 with ROS_LOG_DIR under .omo, then inspect the generated perception node params file; PASS after fix when sync_tolerance_sec is numeric 2.0 and no InvalidParameterTypeException appears in launch transcript.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/perception-sync-param-fix/evidence/red-perception-params.yaml shows sync_tolerance_sec: '2.0'; .omo/ulw-loop/perception-sync-param-fix/evidence/green-perception-params.yaml shows sync_tolerance_sec: 2.0; green launch transcript lacks InvalidParameterTypeException.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: RED .omo/ulw-loop/perception-sync-param-fix/evidence/red-perception-params.yaml line 39 sync_tolerance_sec: '2.0'; GREEN .omo/ulw-loop/perception-sync-param-fix/evidence/green-perception-params.yaml line 39 sync_tolerance_sec: 2.0; .omo/ulw-loop/perception-sync-param-fix/evidence/green-launch-sync-type.txt contains no InvalidParameterTypeException. cleanup: no live QA process; timeout launch exited; ROS_LOG_DIR kept as evidence under .omo.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI verification: run python3 -m py_compile eufs_perception_baseline/launch/perception_baseline.launch.py, colcon build --packages-select eufs_perception_baseline --symlink-install, and python3 -m unittest discover -s eufs_perception_baseline/test -p test_yolov8_launch_wiring.py; PASS when all exit 0.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: py_compile exited 0, colcon build reported 1 package finished, unittest ran 4 tests OK.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: python3 -m py_compile eufs_perception_baseline/launch/perception_baseline.launch.py exited 0; colcon build --packages-select eufs_perception_baseline --symlink-install finished 1 package; python3 -m unittest discover -s eufs_perception_baseline/test -p test_yolov8_launch_wiring.py ran 4 tests OK. cleanup: no live QA process or temp server; build artifacts are normal workspace outputs.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression coverage is included in C002: existing YOLO launch wiring unittest is run after the edit and must remain green.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s eufs_perception_baseline/test -p test_yolov8_launch_wiring.py ran 4 tests OK after the launch typing change.
